render_path: Vulkan strict GPU-native render; NVENC H.264 export

reference.note: Plate is an AI-cleaned still derived from the supplied screenshot; it approximates the scene and is not the original source footage.

commands.raw: chronon3d_cli render --plan T17-reference-look.plan.json --assets-root $PWD --backend vulkan --gpu-hot-path-mode require_gpu_native --start-frame 0 --end-frame 0 --video-sink raw --pipe-pixfmt rgba
commands.video: chronon3d_cli render --plan T17-reference-look.plan.json --assets-root $PWD --backend vulkan --gpu-hot-path-mode require_gpu_native --hardware nvenc --encoder-backend native --pipe-pixfmt nv12 --start-frame 0 --end-frame 59 --fps 30 --output T17-reference-look-2s.mp4

scope_note: This is a still-scene GEL typography/compositing preview. It does not claim original-footage integration, physical volumetric transmission, an extrusion match, or final human visual PASS.
